chunks: Ali, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The one who picks his teeth with reeds, his needs will not be fulfilled for six days.

key_terms.تَخَلَّلَ: to pick teeth / clean teeth with a toothpick

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of using reeds to pick teeth according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) specifies that using reeds (*qasab*) for teeth cleaning results in the delay of one's needs for six days, a ruling distinct from the more common prohibition of using date-palm twigs. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on specific material properties in ritual purity and spiritual efficacy, linking physical hygiene practices to divine decree and the fulfillment of supplications.
